issue: Implement webhook retry with exponential backoff

observations.detail: Tests use the same lightweight custom harness (test/assert with tsx runner) as rate-limit tests. TestableDeliveryManager subclass overrides sleep() to avoid real delays and capture backoff durations for assertions. Follow this subclass-override pattern for testing any async code with delays.

Webhook retry module lives at src/middleware/webhook-retry.ts. Exports WebhookDeliveryManager class, calculateBackoff/isRetryableStatus helpers, and TypeScript interfaces (WebhookDelivery, WebhookRetryOptions, DeliveryPayload, DeliveryResult, DeliverRequest). The deliverFn is injected for testability.
ESM imports use .js extensions (e.g., import from '../middleware/webhook-retry.js'). This matches the existing rate-limit convention and is enforced by type: module in package.json.

Exponential backoff uses base-2 with no jitter: delay = baseDelayMs * 2^attempt. The sleep method is protected so subclasses can override it for testing. Non-5xx responses (including 4xx) are treated as successful delivery to avoid retrying client errors.

The package.json test script was updated to run webhook-retry tests. On the master branch, src/ directory does not exist — it only exists on feature branches. When merging multiple feature branches, the test script needs to be updated to run all test files.
No git remote is configured. Branch 'feature/webhook-retry-exponential-backoff' was created locally from master. A PR cannot be pushed until a remote origin is added.
